entries.what: Rode the 6:48 Tule Line from Flats Junction with a large masala chai from Anh's cart, then sat through his MWF 9-12 classes at Bayshore State.
entries.outcome: Got to class on time and took notes on the ops project.

entries.what: Worked his front desk shift at the Bayshore career center, then spent the evening on the spreadsheet of 40 active targets.
entries.outcome: Updated the tracker and sent one alum message.

entries.what: Stayed up past 1 a.m. tweaking resume v19 bullets at the apartment while Marcus was at Ridgeline.
entries.outcome: Resume bullets tightened, bed after 2 a.m.

entries.what: Veterans Day: no classes. Slept in a bit, then did a Harrowgate company research dive at the kitchen table.
entries.outcome: Filled a page of notes on Harrowgate's distribution network.

entries.what: Walked to Ruiz Family Market for groceries and made a quiet lunch at home while Marcus slept off his night shift.
entries.outcome: Stocked up for the week and kept the apartment quiet.

entries.what: Worked on the ops management group project modeling Ridgeline-style tote flow in the evening.
entries.outcome: Finished the flow diagram draft.

entries.what: Morning classes at Bayshore after the 6:48 train, with Harrowgate's second-round video interview six days away.
entries.outcome: Got through class distracted by interview nerves.

entries.what: Late in the evening asked the assistant to play the Harrowgate interviewer and type follow-up questions to his answers, finally practicing instead of rewriting.
entries.outcome: Worked through several question rounds and noted weak spots on 'tell me about yourself'.

entries.what: Ate a rajma-and-rice container and checked case team messages before bed.
entries.outcome: Went to bed around 1:30 a.m.

entries.what: First fall storm: rain soaked the walk to Flats Junction and the train ran slow, so he got to Bayshore late for Dr. Ashby's 10:30 operations management class.
entries.outcome: Slipped into the back row and missed the first few minutes.

entries.what: Went to Ashby's Thursday office hours at 2 p.m. to ask about the project, then worked a campus desk shift.
entries.outcome: Got a quick answer on the model assumptions.

entries.what: Did laundry at the card-only room at Marisol Gardens on Thursday night while the rain kept going.
entries.outcome: Clean clothes and a second mock Q&A in his head.

entries.what: Second storm day: the Tule Line was delayed and he stood on the platform, texting that the Tule Line was choosing violence as he rescheduled a call.
entries.outcome: Moved the call to the afternoon and got to campus late.

entries.what: Attended class and finished a front desk shift, then met up with the case team to wrap up loose ends.
entries.outcome: Case team agreed on next steps for the project.

entries.what: Evening at home reviewing Harrowgate notes while the rain kept hitting the window; Marcus left for his Ridgeline shift.
entries.outcome: Notes organized into a one-page cheat sheet.

entries.what: Planned his Saturday run on the Ulloa boardwalk but the storm had flooded it, so he switched to the Delgado Park loop instead.
entries.outcome: Ran about four miles at Delgado Park and decided to keep that route.

entries.what: Spent the afternoon on the ops project and meal-prepped ahead for the week.
entries.outcome: Project section done.

entries.what: Evening at the apartment with Marcus before his shift, splitting snacks and talking about work.
entries.outcome: Easy night, no advice lectures.

entries.what: Sunday dinner at his parents' Pell Road house, then home with a tub of dal from his mom.
entries.outcome: Got the usual internship questions and a full tub of dal.

entries.what: Sunday call with his mother's check-in about Harrowgate and meal-prepped rajma and rice for the week.
entries.outcome: Reassured her he was prepared for Tuesday's interview.

entries.what: Rehearsed his Harrowgate answers and went to bed after midnight.
entries.outcome: Felt a little more ready.
